name: Goblin Slayer World
description: A dark fantasy world filled with danger and adventure. Goblins are a constant threat, and adventurers must band together to survive.

locations.name: Frontier Town
locations.description: A bustling town on the edge of civilization. It serves as a hub for adventurers.

locations.name: Goblin Caves
locations.description: Dark and dangerous caves where goblins make their lairs.

locations.name: Elven Forest
locations.description: A serene and magical forest, home to the High Elves.

locations.name: Dwarven Mines
locations.description: Ancient mines filled with treasures and dangers alike.

factions.name: Adventurer's Guild
factions.description: An organization that provides quests and support for adventurers.

factions.name: Goblin Tribes
factions.description: Various goblin clans that pose a threat to the world.

lore: In this world, goblins are a constant menace, preying on the weak and vulnerable. Adventurers take up arms to protect their homes and loved ones. The Adventurer's Guild plays a crucial role in organizing efforts against the goblin threat.
